text:
一年没了 130 万箱蜜蜂
In one year, American beekeepers lost 1.3 million honey bee colonies.

接近年初总数的一半
Nearly half of what they started with.

那美国的蜜蜂快没了？
So, are America's bees running out?

没有。1 月 1 日的总数涨了 6%
No. By January, colonies were up 6%.

总数不降反升
Up, not down.

因为养蜂人一直在补：145 万箱
Because beekeepers kept rebuilding: almost 1.5 million new colonies.

补法有三种
They raise new ones, buy them whole, or give old ones a new queen.

2025 年每个季度的头号威胁：瓦螨
The top stressor, every quarter of 2025: varroa mites.

2026 年初，超过五分之一的蜂群受害
In early 2026, they affected more than one in five colonies.

这一季最糟：三个月没了16%
That quarter was the worst in six: 16% gone in three months.

光加州就没了22 万箱
California alone lost 220,000.

到 6 月，又补了108 万箱
And still, by June, they had added over a million more.

蜜蜂没有消失
The bees aren't vanishing.

是养蜂人在硬撑
Beekeepers are holding the line.
